question: Can the free AI Studio key (HERO_GEMINI_API_KEY, billing disabled) generate images through the Gemini API?
answer: No. The key sees six image models, and every image request is refused with a free-tier limit of 0.

docs.pricing: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (read 2026-10-28): Free Tier column, image output 'Not available' for gemini-2.5-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image
docs.rate_limits: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits (read 2026-10-28): per-tier limits are shown in AI Studio; IPM applies to the image models

runs.branch: claude/gemini-image-probe-1 (one-off probe; the PR's workflow with a push trigger)
runs.result: QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; Quota exceeded for metric generativelanguage.googleapis.com/generate_content_free_tier_requests, limit: 0, model: gemini-2.5-flash-preview-image
QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; generate_content_free_tier_requests, limit: 0, model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image

decision: No image is made on this key and billing stays disabled (owner: no new spending). The route (image.py, gemini-image.yml, tested in PR #516) was removed before merge: nothing unused stays in the project.
